title: Weekend Grindhouse Schedule - Fri 7/31 - Sun 8/2
contentHtml:
Playing this weekend @ 420Grindhouse.

*Showtime starts each day at about Noon PST.

Friday

  • Twin Sitters (1995)
  • Prey of the Jaguar (1996)
  • Squirm (1976)

Friday Grindhouse-A-Go-Go

  • Delirium (1979) aka Psycho Puppet
  • Mutant Hunt (1987)
  • The Spider Labyrinth (1988)

Friday Night Freak Show

  • Death Metal Zombies (1995)
  • Bikini Hotel (1997)

Red Light Saturday Night

Last Call Sunday Night

  • Shark Side Of The Moon (2022)
